name: Twelve Permissions #05 — WHAT ELSE
description: TO WANT MORE WITHOUT GAMBLING THE HOUSE. I wanted to learn investing, and I knew exactly how that story usually goes for someone who learns it with money he cannot afford to lose. I have a family. So the plan was backwards on purpose: build revenue on the side first, and let that pay for the education. This record is dated to the first day that ambition produced something rather than to a day neither I nor anyone else wrote down. Evidence: The first thing it produced: a calculator for government contractors, 6 July 2026.
